items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Well, uh, well, I was with, uh, Jimmy Dawson's band at the time, see.

ctx.x: Another thing we talked about was, uh, the different bands you would meet up with when you were out on the road. Yeah. And you'd run across them. Like your, uh, the two band buses would meet. Oh, yeah.

Well, uh, we were at the Crosby band and we were going, I don't know, north or south. And, and they were coming in on their bus going north or south, something like that. And we'd meet on the road, we'd pull on the side. And that's what, that's what I showed you that picture of Gene Krupa came over. Mm-hmm. Well, uh, well, I was with, uh, Jimmy Dawson's band at the time, see. So, Charlie Teagarden and I jumped out the car and say hello to the guys, you know. Yeah. Because we knew some of the guys that were in…
Did you know Don Albert ever? Yeah. Don Albert. He used to have a band around San Antonio. No, I didn't know nothing about him.

items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: We passed through there with the Jimmy Dorsey band and we played it one night

ctx.x: And they finally went over to Memphis. Natchez? Natchez, Mississippi. Yeah, yeah. And I think Bish passed away there and then Jack passed away too. We passed through there with the Jimmy Dorsey band and we played it one night and I saw him there and I was so happy to see him. But Jack played a wonderful concert. He left the band when Pete Herman, he was playing tennis, saxophone, and clarinet there. But he left that band and went with the Pennsylvania Serenaders, went up north with them for a while and came on…
